summary.text: Jeff Ghrist is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 36 who was first elected in 2014 and has served since 2015, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A real estate agent and former Caroline County commissioner, he serves on the Appropriations Committee and is the House Minority Parliamentarian.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Ghrist was born on March 14, 1975, and attended North Caroline High School in Ridgely and Chesapeake College before earning a B.A. in economics from Salisbury State University in 1997, according to his General Assembly biography.
He is a real estate agent and a former assistant store manager at The Home Depot.
Ghrist served on the Caroline County Board of County Commissioners from 2006 to 2014, as its president in 2010 to 2012 and in 2014 and as vice president in 2013 to 2014.

Ghrist has served on the Appropriations Committee since 2015, including its Capital Budget Subcommittee, and also sits on the Rules and Executive Nominations Committee and the Spending Affordability Committee.
He has been Minority Parliamentarian since 2022, was Deputy Minority Whip from 2019 to 2021, and in 2026 is a co-chair of the House Rural Caucus.
Ballotpedia reports that he advanced from the June 23, 2026 Republican primary.
